description: One root's graph rows, dropped (S30 T5 — index maintenance at the operator tier argued in graph.go: no policy row governs which files are parsed, because parsing is not an action against a resource). Rows and edges go in the store's ONE transaction (edges first, then nodes — no crash leaves edges to gone nodes), and the componentRoot scoping rule is absolute: the root next door does not feel it. Deleting a root with no rows is not an error — it deletes nothing, honestly, with a count of zero.
